description: Pinned versions of every external tool a gate shells out to. The pins existed in five places at once — docs/static-analysis.md, three workflows, and scripts/languages/*.mjs — which is four ways for them to disagree. This file is the source; conformance/checks/tool-versions.test.mjs fails when a copy drifts from it, and scripts/tools/requirements.mjs probes the installed tool against it so `npm run tools:doctor` reports a mismatch instead of only an absence.
